This is the Closed Video Archive for WMCT-TV, Marlborough Community Television.
Our new channel is located at https://www.youtube.com/@WMCT-TVMarlborough
We hope you will follow us there!
We are a local station that is viewed in our hometown of Marlborough Massachusetts as well as the 6 surrounding communities.
WMCT-TV produces in-house programs including "Corner Office", "Superintendent's Corner", "Marlborough Minute" while facilitating productions of Marlborough residents and volunteers.
Why did we move our Youtube Channel- It's a long story... in a nutshell, this channel was not set up correctly from its inception and after years of struggling with management it was time to start fresh.
